_about: Lila's own voice. Created with Grok: every sound in this clip was generated by Grok Imagine (xAI) as the soundtrack of one of the house's own films (a 10 s drill take filmed for Crissa's heads-up harvest); nothing in it is a recording of a person. It is Lila's reference clip for the voices that clone (Chatterbox-Turbo, Chatterbox Multilingual, Audio8). Covered by MEDIA-LICENSE.md like the films: you may use it to run Crissa on devices you control, not to clone the voice for anything else.
transcript: Lips press shut for M. Upper teeth on the lower lip for F. Tongue tip between the teeth. Up behind the teeth for D. Tongue tip up, jaw a little open for L. Lips slightly rounded, jaw nearly shut for R.
transcript_how: The drill's own words, word-timed onto the clip by the house aligner (rail-align, every word placed). The house ASR read it back the same except 'Cut behind the teeth' for 'Up behind the teeth'.
made_from: The film's soundtrack from 0.54 s to its end (10.00 s): 0.54 s of silence cut from the start, and nothing else, since no pause inside it is longer than 0.28 s and the last word ends at 9.92 s. Mixed to mono and resampled from 48 to 24 kHz; no other change: every one-second window of the clip matches the film's sound at correlation 0.99999 or better (checked 2026-10-12).
status: traced, no signature on the source
status_why: The original is a Grok Imagine output saved by the Grok app's image-to-video tool (an API download), which carries no Signature comment tag; its container is laid out exactly like the downloads Crissa's own clip was cut from (Lavf62.18.100, an x264 picture, AAC sound, an MJPEG cover frame). See FILM-PROVENANCE.json's _about.
